generatedProse.practice-connection:
Everything in this course is about the documents you will actually produce. In any discipline, a literature review opens a dissertation and every article you read; a proposal must satisfy a supervisor or an ethics panel before data are gathered; a report in introduction, methodology, results and discussion form is how findings are communicated. Treat what follows as being about your own reviews, proposals and reports, not about research in the abstract.

The same pattern runs well beyond the degree. Wherever evidence has to be gathered, argued from and written up for someone else to judge, these are the genres that carry it. Learning to write each one to its purpose is a habit that lasts long after you graduate.
